event: "Great! I'll be back," Nala tells Ilse, and walks five minutes to Anvil Lane.

memory.fact: Glass Street to Anvil Lane is a five-minute walk; Anvil Lane down to the river stairs, ten.

event: Wil Harrow's forge fronts the lane: a broad, bald smith with a burn-scarred forearm.

memory.fact: Wil Harrow is a broad, bald smith with a burn-scarred forearm; his forge fronts Anvil Lane.

event: Nala lays Voss's sword and Crow's crossbow on his bench; her antler badge slips out with them.
Wil works the crossbow's crank and runs a thumb along the lath. "City work, this. I want it."

memory.fact: Wil calls Crow's crossbow city work, judging its crank and lath, and wants it.
Crow's crossbow is worth 300 copper; Wil is eager for it, saying its crank and lath are city work.

event: He turns the sword, finds the levy stamp, eyes the antler badge, and lets the question lie.

memory.fact: Wil sees the levy stamp on Voss's sword, then Nala's antler badge, and asks nothing more.
Voss's well-kept arming sword is worth 200 copper; Wil is neither eager nor cool for it.

event: "Three gold six for the bow. Two gold two for the blade." He counts it out on the bench.

changes.note: Wil pays 3 gold 6 for Crow's crossbow and 2 gold 2 for Voss's sword

memory.fact: Nala sold Voss's sword and Crow's crossbow to Wil Harrow, and the grubboar tusks to Mother Sallow.

event: "Plain soldier's short swords I take too, sixty copper apiece, if you've any about you."

memory.fact: Wil says he takes plain soldier's short swords too, worth 60 copper each.

event: Nala walks ten minutes down to the river stairs and a steamy cellar at their foot.
Mother Sallow is stooped and old, a clay pipe in her teeth among the bubbling pots.

memory.fact: Mother Sallow is a stooped old woman with a clay pipe, in a steamy cellar at the river stairs' foot.

event: She snatches up the grubboar tusks. "Old ones grind finest." She pays two silver four.

changes.note: Mother Sallow pays two silver four for the old grubboar tusks

memory.fact: Mother Sallow says old grubboar tusks grind finest.
The old Grubboar tusk pair is worth 20 copper; Mother Sallow is eager, grinding tusk for draughts.

event: She squints at Nala's blade and boots. "You've a hunter's look. After the Weir Wyrm?"
"Bring me its bile sac within a day of the kill, and I'll pay two gold for it."

memory.fact: Mother Sallow pays 200 copper for a Weir Wyrm's bile sac brought within a day of the kill.
